parts.name: Apple iPhone AI-capable family (A17 Pro / A18 / A18 Pro / A19 / A19 Pro)
parts.cpu: Apple A17 Pro / A18 family / A19 family
parts.memory_type: soldered mobile memory; exact capacity not published in Apple technical specs
parts.software_stack: iOS; Metal; Core ML; sandboxed local inference apps
parts.plain_language: Modern iPhones are useful low-power inference endpoints, but Apple does not publish RAM capacity in the normal iPhone technical specifications and iOS does not behave like a general-purpose daemon host. Exact memory must come from a separate reliable evidence source before model-fit scoring.
parts.source_notes: Current iPhone 17 uses A19; iPhone 17 Pro uses A19 Pro with Neural Accelerators and a 16-core Neural Engine. RAM is intentionally left unknown rather than inferred from third-party teardowns.
